item.title: Walking, skating or skiing on frozen lakes... it's forbidden!
item.description: With current temperatures dropping to -15 degrees Celsius every night, bodies of water are frozen solid almost everywhere. However, the municipality of Chamonix reminds everyone that walking, skating, or skiing on frozen lakes is strictly prohibited. "Ice is never reliable, even when it appears thick or has already been crossed by others." This primarily concerns Lake Gaillands, but other bodies of water within the municipality are also affected. Chamonix emphasizes that the danger is deadly.

item.title: A person was electrocuted by a rail on the Mont-Blanc Express.
item.description: The grim discovery was made around 5:30 p.m. on Monday, January 12. About twenty meters upstream from the Chamonix Centre train station, a person was found dead along the railway tracks. According to initial reports, the person appears to have been electrocuted by the electrified third rail of the Mont-Blanc Express. The circumstances of the tragedy remain unclear. item.title: Grands Montets, fatal fall for a skier!
item.description: Grands Montets: Skier Found Dead After Falling from a Rocky Cliff The initial search began late Wednesday afternoon, January 21. Around 9 p.m., the Chamonix High Mountain Gendarmerie Platoon (PGHM) was informed by a relative of a worrying disappearance. A 55-year-old man had not returned after a day in the mountains.

item.title: An avalanche has just grazed the Parsa chairlift station at Brévent
item.description: The Brévent ski area remained closed this Friday, and probably rightly so, as an avalanche reached a chairlift.

item.title: Chamonix Valley: three meters of snow in ten days!
item.description: With nearly three meters of snow in ten days and an avalanche risk at its highest level, the ski patrol teams in Chamonix were put to the test. Ski patrollers carried out numerous preventative avalanche control operations and made difficult decisions to ensure skiers' safety.

item.title: New trains for the Mont-Blanc Express this Autumn 2026
item.description: Seven new trains for the Mont-Blanc Express starting in autumn 2026 Blue towards France, red and white towards Switzerland: the future trains of the Mont-Blanc Express will be a compromise between the two countries. Seven Z890-type trains, four for France and three for Switzerland, will gradually enter service between summer 2026 and next autumn on the Le Fayet – Martigny line.

item.title: A large avalanche hits two ski runs in La Flégère
item.description: A large avalanche hits two ski runs in La Flégère Skiers were buried up to their necks in snow: a large avalanche hit two ski runs in Chamonix. Around midday on Tuesday, February 24, an avalanche occurred on the La Flégère ski area. The avalanche originated on the slopes overlooking the top of the Floria ski lift. A 100-meter-wide slab of snow swept across the ski runs: the start of the Crochues red run and the Floria black run.

item.title: Sunday, March 8, 2026: a very busy day for mountain rescue
item.description: With nine rescues on Sunday, March 8th alone, the mountain rescue team of the Chamonix High Mountain Gendarmerie Platoon (PGHM) had their hands full. The first intervention took place in the Vallée Blanche for a skier with a knee injury. Then, the Civil Security's Dragon helicopter was dispatched to various ski areas, including Mont d'Arbois in Saint-Gervais and the Balme ski area in Chamonix. item.title: UTMB 2026: Defending champion Tom Evans returns to defend his title
item.description: He was almost the only one missing! Winner of the 2025 UTMB in 19 hours, 18 minutes, and 58 seconds, Tom Evans will defend his title around Mont Blanc on Friday, August 28. The British athlete officially announced his participation late last week in a video shared by the race organizers, a few days after dropping out of the Transgrancanaria, which was won by Jonathan Albon, another British runner.
